cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item ..\cli\testdata\*.TPS work\ -Force
> node dist\server.js --bogus
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: unknown option --bogus
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --root C:\no\such\folder
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: --root C:\no\such\folder is not a folder
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --exe C:\no\tpscli.exe
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: tpscli.exe not found; tried C:\no\tpscli.exe. Pass --exe <path> or set TPSCLI_EXE.
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --timeout 0
  stderr: tpscli-mcp: --timeout needs a positive whole number of seconds, not 0
  exit 2
> node dist\server.js --root work
  stderr: tpscli-mcp 0.1.0 ready: exe C:\Projects\GitHub\tpscli\cli\tpscli.exe; roots C:\Projects\GitHub\tpscli\mcp\work; writes disabled; owner none; timeout 60s
  exit 0

tps_list_files lists the root folder, filters by pattern, and needs a root
tps_describe shows the layout of a file by bare name or absolute path

cases.title: Encrypted file: owner required, accepted per call, per server and from the environment, and never echoed
Bare names stay inside the roots; without roots only absolute paths work
A read-only server refuses every structured write and changes nothing
tps_query classifies raw statements: writes refused, parse-only allowed, no table for a write
Insert, update, select and delete one row, including a value with a double quote and a backslash
